EN: Not a chance! We've got more gold than anyone in America! That makes us the strongest!
ZH: 门都没有！我们的黄金比全美国任何人都多！所以我们最强！

EN: For the Love of Gold!
ZH: 看在黄金的份上！

EN: We've intercepted a coded plea from someone seeking to break from the Enclave. They're holed up in a civilian outpost ripe for infiltration.
ZH: 我们截获了一段密码求援，来自一个想脱离英克雷的人。他们躲在一处适合渗透的民用哨站里。

EN: Rest for the Wicked
ZH: 恶人的安息

EN: Meet the defector.
ZH: 与叛逃者会面。

EN: Retrieve the defector's pet.
ZH: 找回叛逃者的宠物。

EN: An Enclave defector wants refuge in our vault.
ZH: 一名英克雷叛逃者想在我们的避难所寻求庇护。

EN: Welcome to the Enclave Retirement Center! We don't get visitors often.
ZH: 欢迎来到英克雷养老中心！我们这里不常有访客。

EN: Security!
ZH: 保安！

EN: Oh, you're with *them*. I can get promoted out of here if I stop you!
ZH: 哦，你跟*他们*是一伙的。只要拦下你，我就能升职离开这鬼地方了！

EN: Not with the Enclave? The result of bad parenting, right here. We'll keep an eye on you.
ZH: 不是英克雷的人？这就是家教不善的下场。我们会盯紧你的。

EN: No ID, lady.
ZH: 大姐，我没带证件。

EN: I am a colleague. We shelter many former Enclave ourselves.
ZH: 我是同僚。我们自己就收留了不少前英克雷成员。

EN: We're not with the Enclave, but Grandma is. We're visiting!
ZH: 我们不是英克雷的，但奶奶是。我们来看望她！

EN: I will have to see your ID, though.
ZH: 不过我得看看你的证件。

EN: This is the Final Rest! No better way to spend one's GOLDEN years.
ZH: 这里是“终极安息”！没有比这更好的方式来度过你的“金色”晚年了。

EN: Every ounce of gold is a brick in the fortress of liberty.
ZH: 每一盎司黄金，都是自由堡垒上的一块砖。

EN: Gold is forever while flesh is fleeting.
ZH: 黄金永恒，血肉易逝。

EN: Liberty was born in a cradle of gold.
ZH: 自由诞生于黄金的摇篮。

EN: Speaking of gold, do you have any?
ZH: 说到黄金，你有吗？

EN: Wait, we're not residents, we're visitors. Much too young to retire…
ZH: 等等，我们不是住户，是访客。还太年轻，退不了休……

EN: I feel like no matter what I say, you'll igore it.
ZH: 感觉不管我说什么，你都会无视掉。

EN: Who are you? Out. Out! I don't want visitors.
ZH: 你是谁？出去。出去！我不想见访客。

EN: How insulting! You youngsters have it easy with... err... your tiny Radscorpions and friendly Radroaches...
ZH: 真没礼貌！你们这些年轻人日子好过多了，靠着……呃……你们那小小的辐射蝎和友善的辐射蟑螂……

EN: Throw 'em in a vat for all I care! Oh, alright! I don't need my uniform anymore, I guess. Take it and leave.
ZH: 把他们扔进培养大桶里我都不在乎！噢，好吧！我想我再也用不上我的制服了。拿去然后快滚。

EN: Are you trying to grift me? You'll never find my gold. Scram!
ZH: 你想讹我吗？你永远找不到我的黄金。滚开！

EN: Geez, grampa! Out of meds?
ZH: 天呐，老大爷！药吃完了？

EN: Apologies. I'm simply collecting donations for Enclave orphans.
ZH: 抱歉。我只是在为英克雷孤儿募捐。

EN: Rent's up.
ZH: 房租涨了。

EN: Aaaargh Mole rats!
ZH: 啊啊啊，鼹鼠！

EN: Exactly what a Mole rat would say...
ZH: 正是一只鼹鼠会说的话……

EN: What? I'm no Mole rat.
ZH: 什么？我不是鼹鼠。

EN: Who do we have here? Got out of your room again?
ZH: 这是谁来了？又溜出房间了？

EN: Calling me "Big Nurse" behind my back again?
ZH: 又在我背后叫我“大护士”？

EN: I'll show you the mercy people like you deserve.
ZH: 我会让你见识见识，你这种人该得到怎样的慈悲。

EN: The sunset is beautiful, don't you think? I don't have many of those left.
ZH: 夕阳很美，你不觉得吗？我可没剩多少黄昏可看了。

EN: Showed mercy to my enemy once. The next day, he rallied the survivors and struck back. Lost many friends.
ZH: 我曾对我的敌人慈悲过一次。第二天，他就集结幸存者反击回来。我失去了很多朋友。

EN: The restoration of America, but I'm out of time! You, you still have some life left in you. You do it.
ZH: 重建美利坚，可我没时间了！你，你还有命可活。这件事交给你了。

EN: You're an emotional one, aren't you. Maybe the Enclave isn't for you, then.
ZH: 你真是个多愁善感的家伙，对吧。那也许英克雷不适合你。

EN: Do you have any regrets?
ZH: 你有什么遗憾吗？

EN: Anything left on your bucket list?
ZH: 还有什么遗愿清单没完成吗？

EN: Ah! I'm not crying, you're crying!
ZH: 啊！我没哭，是你哭了！

EN: Tell that crone it's my pet now. Shoo! Shoo!
ZH: 告诉那个老太婆，现在它是我的宠物了。走开！走开！

EN: Oh, you're not with her? Then can you take my sweetie for a walk? My legs ain't what they used to…
ZH: 哦，你不是和她一伙的？那你能带我的小宝贝出去散散步吗？我的腿脚大不如前了……

EN: You're a cruel one, threatening to toss your former best sniper to the street... Go on, break my heart!
ZH: 你真是个残忍的家伙，居然威胁要把你曾经最好的神枪手赶到大街上……去吧，伤我的心吧！

EN: <PLAY DUMB> What are you talking about?
ZH: <装傻> 你在说什么啊？

EN: Animal control! Give it up, or face eviction.
ZH: 动物管制！把它交出来，否则就得扫地出门。

EN: Hey! Being here and talking to you feels so strange.
ZH: 嘿！能待在这儿跟你说话，感觉可真奇怪。

EN: That's kind of you to say. But, you know, I have my ways…
ZH: 你这么说真客气。不过，你知道的，我有我的门路……

EN: I was always one to hear Dwellers' feedback, but you'll have to find a new set of ears.
ZH: 我向来乐于听取居民们的意见，不过你恐怕得另找一双耳朵了。

EN: Enjoy the peaceful days ahead of you. It seems we owe you a lot.
ZH: 好好享受你眼前平静的日子吧。看来我们欠你很多。

EN: Vault technology is decades old. You don't look that old to me.
ZH: 避难所的科技是几十年前的老古董了。我看你可没那么老。

EN: I have a list of complaints. If I write them down, will you read it?
ZH: 我有一堆投诉意见。如果我写下来，你会看吗？

EN: I used to run things, you know.
ZH: 你知道吗，我以前是管事的。

EN: That vault you live in? I led its construction, I bet.
ZH: 你住的那座避难所？我敢说，它的建设是我主持的。

EN: I'm not really Enclave, but finding a retirement home in the Wasteland is hard. So here I am.
ZH: 我其实算不上英克雷的人，但在废土上找养老院太难了。所以我就待这儿了。

EN: Visitor! Leave the premises. This resident is in the middle of a loyalty test.
ZH: 访客！请离开此地。这位居民正在进行忠诚度测试。

EN: Incorrect: Freedom is the golden rule granted by the pursuit of wealth.
ZH: 错误：自由是追求财富所赋予的黄金法则。

EN: You are unpatriotic! Leave us be.
ZH: 你不爱国！离我们远点。

EN: Oh! I know that one! Freedom is doing whatever you want! Damn the consequences!
ZH: 哦！这个我知道！自由就是想干什么就干什么！管它什么后果！

EN: Hey resident! Want us to smack those bots?
ZH: 嘿，居民！想让我们替你教训这几个机器人吗？

EN: Let us just slip by, thank you very much.
ZH: 让我们偷偷溜过去，多谢了。

EN: Resident, answer this: what is true freedom?
ZH: 居民，回答这个问题：什么是真正的自由？

EN: Ah! You made it! Get me out of here! Now!
ZH: 啊！你来了！带我离开这里！现在！

EN: I'll play dead. Pretend to hit me, make it look real. Oh, and if you can, get my pet. That crazy lady stole it from me.
ZH: 我来装死。假装打我，演得逼真点。对了，你要是能的话，帮我把宠物带回来。那个疯婆子把它抢走了。

EN: Give me a second. Oh, and I can't find my pet, so if you can oblige...
ZH: 给我点时间。对了，我找不到我的宠物了，你要是方便的话……

EN: I'm still coming. And also, get my pet. It's probably with that hag in her room…
ZH: 我还是要去。另外，把我的宠物救出来。它多半被那个老巫婆关在她房间里……

EN: Well, our vault never sleeps. You are welcome to slip out with us.
ZH: 好说，我们的避难所从不打烊。欢迎你跟我们一起溜出去。

EN: Gather your things, time to go!
ZH: 收拾好你的东西，该走了！

EN: You don't look very knowledgeable... or skilled. We'll pass.
ZH: 你看起来不怎么懂行……也没什么本事。我们算了。

EN: This place is awful. They only feed us mush. The only entertainment is singing Enclave anthems.
ZH: 这地方糟透了。他们只喂我们糊糊。唯一的娱乐就是唱英克雷国歌。

EN: Lights are out at 6PM. SIX.
ZH: 晚上6点就熄灯。六点啊！

EN: We've been invited to opening night of an Enclave play. It screams trap, but we can turn it into a golden opportunity!
ZH: 我们受邀参加英克雷一部戏剧的首演之夜。这明显是陷阱，但我们可以把它变成天赐良机！

EN: Mystery Enclave Theater 3000
ZH: 英克雷神秘剧场3000

EN: Meet the director.
ZH: 与导演会面。

EN: Witness an existential scene.
ZH: 见证一场存在主义的戏。

EN: Witness a love scene.
ZH: 见证一场爱情戏。

EN: Attend the opening night of the Enclave play.
ZH: 出席英克雷戏剧的首演之夜。

EN: Two factions, both alike in enmity, in the fair Wasteland, where we lay our scene,
ZH: 两个阵营，仇怨相当，在这美丽的废土上，我们拉开了序幕，

EN: From forth the fatal vaults of these two foes, a pair of star-cross robots, take their strife.
ZH: 这一对苦命的机器人，从仇敌那致命的避难所中，开始了他们的恩怨。

EN: Errr... There's something wrong with you. Mind if I check your code?
ZH: 呃……你有毛病吧。介意我检查下你的代码吗？

EN: Ooooh, has the play started already? Continue. Continue.
ZH: 哦哦哦，戏剧已经开场了？继续。继续。

EN: From ancient gold break to new currency, where Dwellers' blood makes Enclave hands unclean.
ZH: 从古旧的黄金中裂变出新的货币，居民的血，染污了英克雷的双手。

EN: To be or not to be, that is my question…
ZH: 生存还是毁灭，这是我的问题……

EN: Does not compute. Error. Remove non-actors.
ZH: 无法计算。错误。移除非演员。

EN: Line missing. Dispensing motivation.
ZH: 台词缺失。发放动力中。

EN: Wait! Are we switching plays now? Err... I think therefore I be?
ZH: 等等！我们现在换剧了吗？呃……我思故我在？

EN: <Stay Silent>
ZH: <保持沉默>

EN: <searching> Line not found.
ZH: <搜索中> 未找到台词。

EN: What's in a name? That which we call a rose by any other name would smell as sweet.
ZH: 名字有什么要紧？玫瑰即使换了名字，也依旧芳香。

EN: Updating database. Awaiting programming. Take this to director.
ZH: 更新数据库。等待编程。把这个交给导演。

EN: Error. Name of character is Horatio, who is the totally original author and director of this play. Remove youself.
ZH: 错误。角色名为霍雷肖，他是本剧完全原创的作者兼导演。请你自行退出。

EN: Sorry, I don't do interactive theater. I'll just take my leave.
ZH: 抱歉，我不参与互动戏剧。我这就告辞。

EN: Actually, you should be saying a couple more lines before my turn.
ZH: 其实，在我上场之前，你该再多说几句台词。

EN: I take thee at thy word. Call me but love, and I'll be new baptized. Henceforth I never will be Romeo.
ZH: 只要你肯叫我一声爱人，我便重新受洗；从此不再是罗密欧。

EN: *Your line now*
ZH: *现在轮到你了*

EN: Oh my gosh. This is the dressing room. No peaking. Out. Out. Out.
ZH: 哦天哪。这是化妆间。不许偷看。出去。出去。出去。

EN: Ah, a fan... Let me give you my autograph and a care package.
ZH: 啊，一位粉丝……让我给你签个名，还有一份爱心礼包。

EN: Guard, where art thou?
ZH: 保安，你在何方？

EN: But your circuits are so golden, and your declamation routine is a beautiful singleton!
ZH: 可你的线路如此金光闪闪，你的朗诵桥段又是如此优美的单例！

EN: I go where I please.
ZH: 我想去哪就去哪。

EN: We serve the Fairy Queen, to dew her orbs upon the green…
ZH: 我们侍奉仙后，去把露珠洒满那绿野……

EN: Wish granted.
ZH: 心愿达成。

EN: We will wait for the costume designer. Bring it this payment.
ZH: 我们会等待服装设计师。把这份报酬带给他。

EN: Fairies? Fairies grant wishes, no? I wish for gold.
ZH: 精灵？精灵能满足愿望，对吧？我许愿要黄金。

EN: Hmm... Maybe some wings made of paper maché, and a cute tutus, you could pass for fairies.
ZH: 嗯……也许做些纸浆翅膀，再配上可爱的芭蕾短裙，你们就能冒充精灵了。

EN: We are those merry wanderers of the night.
ZH: 我们是夜里的欢乐漫游者。

EN: Come on, you lazy rat substitute! It's not complicated.
ZH: 快点，你这个懒惰的耗子替身！这又不复杂。

EN: Isn't it obvious? I'm training these good-for-nothing pests as stage hands. Don't interfere.
ZH: 这还不明显吗？我在训练这些没用的害虫当后台杂工。别捣乱。

EN: Perhaps you'd be interested in an unpaid internship then? Think on it and come back to me.
ZH: 那也许你对无薪实习感兴趣？想想再回来找我。

EN: What's going on here?
ZH: 这里发生了什么？

EN: We can't get any good help these days.
ZH: 如今想找点得力帮手可真难。

EN: Just move the décor to the scene. Aim the spotlight at the actor. Pull the lever to lift the fairies in the air.
ZH: 把布景搬到场景里。把聚光灯对准演员。拉下杠杆，把精灵们升到空中。

EN: Yes, I am THE director!
ZH: 没错，我就是那位导演！

EN: What? But that killed last time... Quite literally. I will perform for you!
ZH: 什么？但上次这招效果炸裂啊……字面意义上的炸裂。我这就为你表演！

EN: You are just like the rest of them. They prefer chasing gold to chasing art...
ZH: 你跟他们一样。比起追逐艺术，他们更喜欢追逐黄金……

EN: People of great taste raised you well! Please take this with you as a token of my gratitude
ZH: 高雅之士把你培养得真好！请带上这个，算是我的一点微薄谢意。

EN: How foul and loathsome is thine image!
ZH: 君之形象何其丑陋可憎！

EN: You speak an infinite deal of nothing.
ZH: 你说了一堆毫无意义的废话。

EN: Thy constellation is right apt for this affair.
ZH: 你的星座，正适合这场盛事。

EN: Be honest, what did you think of my totally original play?
ZH: 老实说，你觉得我这完全原创的戏剧怎么样？

EN: We caught an odd signal inviting Enclave to a refuge in a former NCR base located in a mausoleum. Worth a look.
ZH: 我们捕捉到一个奇怪的信号，邀请英克雷前往一处位于陵墓中的前NCR基地避难。值得去看看。

EN: Strange Bedfellows
ZH: 同床异梦的盟友

EN: Find the one who doesn't belong
ZH: 找到那个不属于这里的人

EN: Investigate a former NCR base
ZH: 调查一处前NCR基地

EN: Welcome to our little Sanctuary. Are you NCR or Enclave?
ZH: 欢迎来到我们的小小庇护所。你们是NCR还是英克雷？

EN: If you leave behind the ambitions of the narcicists, you can find peace.
ZH: 若能放下那些自恋者的野心，你便能寻得安宁。

EN: Bad answer. We are in this together, and will defend one another.
ZH: 这个回答可不太妙。我们同舟共济，会互相守护。

EN: Those who come here have forsworn violence. You may enter, but keep the peace.
ZH: 来这里的人，都已立誓弃绝暴力。你可以进来，但要保持和平。

EN: You sound like the local Enclave leader. We will stop you!
ZH: 你说话像本地的英克雷头子。我们会阻止你的！

EN: NCR and Enclave living together? How is that possible?
ZH: NCR和英克雷住在一起？这怎么可能？

EN: Stand aside, we are here to defeat the Enclave.
ZH: 让开，我们是来打败英克雷的。

EN: Neither, we are Vault Dwellers, seeking former Enclave to recruit.
ZH: 都不是，我们是避难所居民，想招募前英克雷成员。

EN: Forget all that. Where's your gold?
ZH: 少废话。你们的黄金藏哪儿了？

EN: Are you here to join our little Enclave support group?
ZH: 你是来加入我们这个小英克雷互助小组的吗？

EN: No, wait, don't let your trauma win!
ZH: 不，等等，别让你的创伤得逞！

EN: There. There. Is this what you were fussing about?
ZH: 好啦，好啦。闹了半天，就是为了这个呀？

EN: Violence is not the solution. Return when you've welcomed peace into your heart.
ZH: 暴力不是解决办法。等你心中迎入和平后再来吧。

EN: It's an Enclave ambush! Weapons ready!
ZH: 这是英克雷的埋伏！武器上膛！

EN: Sniff. I have found gold, and... and... the... the Enclave tried to take it from me, and they're big meanies...
ZH: 呜咽。我找到了黄金，然后……然后……英克雷想把它抢走，他们都是大坏蛋……

EN: Hurt me? No, I hurt them.
ZH: 伤害我？不，是我伤害他们。

EN: Please share with us. How did the Enclave hurt you?
ZH: 请跟我们说说。英克雷当年是怎么伤害你的？

EN: Dispensary. Need anything?
ZH: 药品供应处。需要点什么？

EN: Raiders! Don't let them steal the medicine!
ZH: 掠夺者！别让他们偷走药品！

EN: Looting a place full of former military sounds like a real smart plan!
ZH: 洗劫一个满是前军人的地方，听起来真是个妙计！

EN: You want our paperweight? You're a strange one.
ZH: 你想要我们的镇纸？你可真是个怪人。

EN: We keep some to defend ourselves, but you can have this one.
ZH: 我们自己留了一些防身，但这个可以给你。

EN: Hand over all your chems!
ZH: 把你们所有的药物都交出来！

EN: This place looks ripe for a little bit of looting.
ZH: 这地方看起来挺适合搜刮一番的。

EN: Gold, if you have any.
ZH: 黄金，如果你们有的话。

EN: Since you all let go of the fight, can I get your weapons?
ZH: 既然你们都放下了武器，能让我拿走你们的枪吗？

EN: What I am saying is that the Enclave had it right.
ZH: 我的意思是，英克雷的做法是对的。

EN: Then you'll be the one who gets shot, NCR lover! My friend here will surely reward you for siding with him.
ZH: 那你就是那个要挨枪子儿的人，NCR走狗！只要站到他那边去，我这位朋友肯定少不了你的赏。

EN: Exactly! Democracy brought to the Wasteland. You deserve my favorite gun. Take good care of Henrietta.
ZH: 正是！把民主带到废土。你配得上我最心爱的枪。好好照顾亨丽埃塔。

EN: Wrong move. Time to kick your testosterone down a notch!
ZH: 走错棋了。是时候给你过剩的雄性激素降降温了！

EN: That's a fair point. If you tire of your vault, come stay here and debate with us.
ZH: 说得有理。要是你在避难所呆腻了，欢迎来这儿跟我们一起辩论。

EN: That's Enclave propaganda, if I ever heard one. You can't just shoot whomever you have beef with.
ZH: 这绝对是我听过最典型的英克雷洗脑宣传。你不能因为跟谁有矛盾就一枪崩了谁。

EN: The NCR has lost their way. The Enclave could rise up in the open and offer a true alternative.
ZH: NCR已经迷失方向。英克雷或许能公开崛起，提供一个真正的替代方案。

EN: It doesn't matter. Whoever has the biggest guns makes the law, and that's us.
ZH: 那都不重要。谁枪杆子最粗谁说了算，而那个人就是我们。

EN: The key is healthy debate, without violence, just like the one you're having.
ZH: 关键在于健康的辩论，不动用暴力，就像你们正在进行的这样。

EN: I disliked their method, but their goal of order and security is laudable.
ZH: 我讨厌他们的手段，但他们追求秩序与安全的目标值得称赞。

EN: You say the NCR also stands for those values, and yet your streets are full of criminals.
ZH: 你说NCR也信奉这些价值观，可你们的街头满是罪犯。

EN: And your so-called justice system just lets them walk.
ZH: 而你们那所谓的司法系统，还任由他们逍遥法外。

EN: <shhh> This is a place of mourning.
ZH: <嘘> 这是哀悼之地。

EN: Friends, we need to teach these "comedians" some respect.
ZH: 朋友们，我们得给这帮“搞笑艺人”一点教训，让他们学会尊重。

EN: <The people assembled nod to you, and hand you something.>
ZH: <在场的人们朝你点头，并递给你一样东西。>

EN: <One mourner looked interested.>
ZH: <一位哀悼者露出了感兴趣的神情。>

EN: What's wrong with you?
ZH: 你到底有什么毛病？

EN: Morning? But this is afternoon!
ZH: 早上？可这明明是下午！

EN: <Stay Silent>
ZH: <保持沉默>

EN: <Hand over invitations to join your vault>
ZH: <递上加入你们避难所的邀请函>

EN: All Enclave must perish. Let's add a couple more names to those tombs!
ZH: 所有英克雷都必须灭亡。让我们再往这些坟墓上添几个名字吧！

EN: This place looks like a dead end.
ZH: 这地方看起来像个死胡同。

EN: <Thanks to your PERCEPTION, you spot a hidden door in the back.>
ZH: <凭借你的观察力，你发现后面有一扇隐藏的门。>

EN: Interesting. I wonder what's on the other side.
ZH: 有意思。我好奇门后有什么。

EN: The Vault Dwellers! How did you find me?
ZH: 避难所居民！你们怎么找到我的？

EN: Sure. Just give me all your gold! ... Yeah, didn't think so.
ZH: 行啊。那把你的黄金全都交给我吧！……是啊，我想也没戏。

EN: Is that true? Then all that's left for me is to tie up loose ends.
ZH: 是真的吗？那我剩下的活儿，就是把你们这些“尾巴”清理干净了。

EN: As if that was ever an option!
ZH: 说得好像这曾是个选项似的！

EN: Here's an alternative: how about you defect to us?
ZH: 给你另一条出路：叛逃加入我们怎么样？
